0022600215.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-9, 14th in the West) host the Orlando Magic (2-7, 12th in the East) in the Kings' 11th game of the season, with Sacramento on a three-game losing streak and 0-5 at home, while Orlando has lost four straight and is 0-4 on the road. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (out, Achilles surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (out, dislocated knee), and Domantas Sabonis (knee soreness) and Keegan Murray (wrist soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (out, knee), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee), Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (out, ankle sprain), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after the Kings lost both 2025-26 meetings, most recently 121-117 in Orlando on March 26.
